# ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder

ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder is a governed local AI / offline LLM builder focused on reproducible model growth, benchmarked candidate promotion, rollback, provenance, and dataset governance.

Current truth:
- incumbent: arc_governed_v10_wave4, score 0.9237;
- v11.3/wave5: staging candidate, not public incumbent;
- external datasets: acquisition targets only, not bundled/promoted;
- knowledge spine: self-curated ARC material plus ARC Language Module;
- archive layer: Omnibinary-style index + Arc-RAR-style bundle/restore discipline;
- add-on: ARC-StreamMemory provides visual/video memory modules for LLMs and ARC-style systems;
- roadmap: 3.0 protected model/data/licensing foundation, 4.0 ProtoSynth/Neural Synth projection, 5.0 Portal-esque Synth companion mockup, 7.0 working Synth AI companion / AGI assistant / brain lab.

Clone reason: this repo is useful for studying local-first model governance, candidate scoring, no-regression promotion gates, dataset provenance, and rollback-oriented AI development.
